comment: Happy Retirement Dr. Evans! This class was extremely interesting and while I know you'll enjoy the extra time, you were a great professor to have and a lot of knowledge is retiring with you.

Introduction to Entomology is a super interesting class and Dr. Evans is an extremely knowledgeable expert in his field. The assignments are time consuming, but straight forward. If you put in the time, anyone can get an A+ guaranteed. Super glad I took this course, it will make you appreciate the natural world
